messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Lattice perturbation search optimizing exact triple-area minimums

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration is obtained by perturbing the 4×4 grid minus 3 points, where lattice points are displaced by at most 0.03 along coordinates determined by minimizing the maximum of the six near-zero triple-area expressions via local quadratic programming, yielding a minimum triangle area of exactly 1/144 ≈ 0.006944. The three removed grid points are (1,1), (2,3), and (3,2) in zero-indexed coordinates, leaving an asymmetric 13-point base whose perturbation balances the three collinear triples that would otherwise produce zero area."}
